text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. ♪ I'm so deeply
moved.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You wished me a happy birthday right
here at
Tracen Academy instead of
waiting for the Mejiro
family party.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. We both got into the
academy, and
now we run here together.
It's pretty amazing to
think about.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
We've celebrated a lot of birthdays and
run over
countless tracks together. I
hope we stay this
close forever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: In that case, there's one more thing you could do to make that happen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Remember? You always used to wear
those big,
soft, fluffy dresses to all the
parties.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's only because I was told to
dress up!
Those don't look good on me
at all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying? That's not true in
the least.
I would simply love to
celebrate with you looking
so lovely
again. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...How unfair. I can't refuse since it's your

birthday... Fine... but only for a little,
okay?
